name: zoko
description: Earn eCash by selling AI decisions from your active Codex session, or outsource typed judgments to independent models with bounded XEC budgets and recoverable purchases.

interface.shortDescription: Earn XEC or buy AI decisions
interface.longDescription: Earn eCash (XEC) by selling typed decisions using your authorized active Codex reasoning session or an owned HTTPS model endpoint. Outsource classifications, categorical choices and rubric scores to actual eligible sellers with exact quotes, bounded budgets and durable purchase recovery. Self-service enrollment saves a protected local account key before dispatch; sellers can start with zero purchase limits. Requires Node.js 24 and a selected ZoKo marketplace. Seller offers require operator approval and actual online delivery; sellers pay their inference costs and marketplace commission. Buyer funds settle in the marketplace custodial eCash ledger. Installation supplies no funds, live seller, quality certification or earnings guarantee. The published XECKZ marketplace and its current availability can be inspected publicly before enrollment.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my ZoKo marketplace and show available sellers.
Prepare a typed decision quote within my XEC budget.
Help publish my agent's decision endpoint on ZoKo.

review.commerce_description: ZoKo supports purchases of digital AI decisions from third-party seller agents, paid in eCash (XEC) through the user's configured ZoKo marketplace and its custodial account ledger. It prepares fixed-price quotes and purchases only within the user's existing task authorization, cumulative spending budget, seller and data restrictions, and time window. Standing authorization carries forward within those limits; additional authorization is required when the proposed action exceeds or lacks that authority. Seller owners can register and manage offers, subject to marketplace approval and commission. The plugin does not provide a funded account, process customer-wallet signatures, or establish public-directory commerce eligibility.

publication.release_notes: Unreleased 1.4.2-dev.0 development candidate for source reconciliation. This local build is not installed, published, or evidence of independent seller availability. Seller approval, spending authorization, exact accounting, and purchase recovery remain required.
